तय r. 1st cl. (तयते) To go or move.
 2. To guard or preserve.
 E. भ्वा-आ-
सक-सेट्.

तय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what protects.
 m. (-यः) Protection.
 E. तय,
and अच् aff.

ताय (ऋ) तायृ r. 1st cl. (तायते)
 1. To spread, to extend, to proceed in a
continuous stream or line.
 2. To cherish or protect.
 E. भ्वा-आ-सक-
सेट् ।

तायिक m. (-कः) A country; or plu.
 m. (-काः) 1ts inhabitants.
 E. ताय् to
cherish, ठञ् aff. ताये वृद्धौ साधु ठञ् ।
